title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Blueberry Strawberry Burst 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Blueberry Strawberry Burst Nic Salt e-liquid brings together two of the most popular fruit flavours, combining the juicy sweetness of Blueberries with the bright, tangy taste of Strawberries. This e-liquid provides a perfectly balanced fruit blend that’s deliciously refreshing. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are designed for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod systems, offering a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine relief. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid provides a flavour-packed vape experience that can be enjoyed throughout the day. Pukka Juice is known for its award-winning e-liquids, and the Pukka Juice 5000+ range delivers intense, disposable-inspired flavours for use with reusable vape devices. Other great flavours in the range include Lime Twist, Fizzy Pop, and Tropical.
